items.title: Banjul North Lawmaker Defies Barrow’s Threat, Holds President Responsible for His Safety
items.summary: By Staff Writer Banjul North National Assembly member Modou Lamin B. Bah has vowed not to be silenced after President Adama Barrow threatened him with severe consequences for participating in a youth-led protest at State House, which the president described as a treasonable of...
items.author: Staff Writer
